capabilities: Run AI coding CLIs in a right sidebar terminal
Open parallel sessions in tabs with per-tab process controls
Insert the active file or folder as a mention
Schedule prompts from markdown files on an interval or cron
Log and export automation run history
disambiguation: Not an AI assistant itself; it only runs AI coding CLIs that you install separately on your computer.
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly). The native node-pty backend is optional and must be installed separately; without it the plugin falls back to a Python PTY bridge or a direct pipe. Max concurrent sessions can be capped to limit automation spawns.
problem: AI coding CLIs run outside Obsidian, so using them on your notes means switching apps and losing the vault as the working directory.

relations.evidence: Run any local AI coding CLI — Claude, Codex, or your own — inside a right sidebar terminal
Claude and Codex are pre-populated on first install.
opencode | Open-source, works with many AI providers
Ollama | Runs AI models fully locally (offline, private)

requires.name: AI coding CLI (e.g. Claude Code, Codex)
AI CLI sign-in or API key

summary: Sidebar terminal panel that runs external AI coding CLIs such as Claude Code and Codex in parallel tabs, with scheduled prompt automations.
